title: Acetaria: A Discourse of Sallets
author: John Evelyn
description: "Acetaria: A Discourse of Sallets" by John Evelyn is a horticultural and culinary treatise written in the late 17th century.
longDescription: This work explores the various types and preparations of salads, or "sallets," emphasizing the importance of plants and herbs in the diet, particularly in relation to vegetarianism.

authorInfo.bio: John Evelyn (1620–1706) wrote Acetaria: A Discourse of Sallets. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
